reason: A managed plugin infrastructure layer providing dependency resolution, lockfiles, lifecycle control, packaging and restoration, CLI commands, and an optional web management panel.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 插件提供依赖解析、锁定、安装管理、生命周期控制、打包恢复及 CLI 和 Web 面板扩展能力。
summaries.en: Provides DSH plugins with dependency resolution, lockfiles, installation management, lifecycle control, packaging and restoration, plus CLI and web panel extensions.

capabilities: Installs, resolves, locks, activates, deactivates, replaces, and restores managed plugins
Packages and restores plugin bundles through CLI commands
Provides a web panel for plugin installation, configuration, lifecycle control, and BOM export
Supports plugin sources including GitHub, folders, and compressed archives
Supports registry storage through SQLite or PostgreSQL extensions
